summary: Reproduced the independent review against candidate commit d99a42f9f4a3fc755d9053ace0954f985f37e44b. Its primary BlockScan documentation example made consecutive inclusive and exclusive calls using the same shared storage without the required intervening fx.barrier(), despite the contract later requiring that barrier. Added the barrier while preserving the candidate's documentation and independent GPU boundary tests. The delivery PR references the assigned mirror issue rather than the candidate PR's incorrect issue 543, and explicitly treats block-wide prefix scan as one scoped contribution rather than completion of the broad building-block proposal.

remaining_limitations: This explicitly scoped contribution provides and validates block-wide prefix scan only; it does not resolve the original proposal's broader set of common GPU building blocks.
Only gfx950 was available and validated; other architectures, including wave32 targets, remain unverified.
BlockScan remains limited to power-of-two thread counts, full-block participation, the WARP_SCANS policy, and ReductionOp ADD/MUL/MIN/MAX.
No native C++ source changed, so the prepared native rebuild was not applicable and was not run.
The candidate PR's incorrect mirror issue URL is immutable historical PR text; this correction's PR body uses the assigned mirror issue https://github.com/amdpilot-org/FlyDSL/issues/604.
